name: Forma
tagline: Ready-made website for construction and renovation companies
description: Forma is a website template for construction and renovation companies, with services, a project gallery, a work process and a contact form. Light surfaces, graphite typography and an amber accent give it a calm, architectural character. Replace the sample copy, photos and logo with your own before publishing.
features: Hero section with a clear call to action
Services overview for construction and renovation work
Project gallery to replace with your own photography
Collaboration principles and work process steps
Testimonials, to be replaced with genuine feedback
